name: Scenic Beauty of Historic Districts (Wuhan)
description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views from historic areas of Jiang'an, Jianghan and Wuchang districts in Wuhan (the paper's districts lie in these three administrative districts; the streets were chosen for this template), not the paper's stimuli. Each participant rates 10 street views, drawn at random from the three areas, on aesthetic appeal, comfort and historical ambiance from −3 (extremely dislike) to +3 (extremely like), as in the Scenic Beauty Estimation survey of Xu, Yang & Guo (2025, Buildings). The paper z-scored each participant's ratings and removed responses that failed an attention check, were faster than one-third of the median time, or gave the same rating to every image; an attention-check question is included here.
author: Xu, Yang & Guo
